name: Go4Brains High-School Summer Neuroscience Program
org: University of Minnesota, Department of Neuroscience
what_you_do: A one week program. Students hold a human brain and get an EEG brain print. They tour research labs, run their own experiments and work with mentors. They also show a poster.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 9 to 11 who have met barriers to science and medicine chances. The program focuses on high schoolers in the Twin Cities area.
pay_detail: Free for selected students; meals and travel are covered and students get a $400 stipend.
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was March 1, 2026,. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill in the enrollment survey on the program site. Send back the signed form by the deadline. You need a letter of support from a science teacher or a group leader.
notes: The site says both ten and twelve students are chosen, so it is a small cohort.
